meta.title: Skill library
meta.description: 100 agent skills in one bundle: syafiqkit workflows (commits, shipping, task docs, UI/UX design judgement, animation) plus engineering (test-first, debugging, planning, code review), security review (OWASP, LLM and privacy checks), documentation, UX and accessibility audits, and video (Remotion captions, explainers, b-roll, vlog editing). Ask for a skill by name or let the agent choose. Skills load with a note mapping Claude Code tools to Harness tools. Set outputStyle: true for syafiqkit's answer style; exclude hides skills. Video skills need Node, ffmpeg or Remotion installed.
